title: Trost Richards Watercolor
content: Blog reader (1833-1905) Daroo asked to see more gouache paintings by William Trost Richards. This 9x14 inch gem, calledLake Squam from Red Hill(1874) is from the Metropolitan Museum's collection,link.Trost Richards combined the luminous grandeur of Turner with an American PreRaphaelite sense of carefully observed detail. He often worked semi-opaque watercolor over a gray-green tone paper.Here's a plein air seascape that captures the full range of big waves, ripples, foam, and recoil. WTR is best known for his seascapes and his Adirondack mountainscapes.You can see a variety of WTR works for sale at William Varieka Fine Arts,link.Another good website is "William Trost Richards, The Complete Works,"link.
